configurePresets.name: default
configurePresets.description: Release build with Ninja; honours the in-tree compile/link JOB_POOLS cap so plain `cmake --build build --parallel` is safe on 32 GiB hosts.

configurePresets.name: workstation
configurePresets.description: Release build hard-capped at -j3 for 8–16 GiB workstations or laptops where even the in-tree JOB_POOLS heuristic (max(2, nproc/4)) feels too aggressive — for instance, a Qt+terminal session running concurrently with the build. Pair with `cmake --build --preset=workstation`.

configurePresets.name: debug
configurePresets.description: Debug build with -gsplit-dwarf and the AddressSanitizer + UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer toggle (ANTS_SANITIZERS=ON). Drops `-O2` cost from test bundles and surfaces use-after-free / signed-overflow / null-deref at runtime.

configurePresets.name: fast
configurePresets.description: Release build in an isolated directory (build-fast/) so hot-loop work doesn't invalidate the default build/ cache. Real differentiator vs default: ANTS_LINK_POOL=2 lifts the global link cap to 2 concurrent invocations so the ~30 test-bundle link tail runs in pairs instead of serially — a measurable win on cold full rebuilds on a 32 GiB host. ccache + per-lib PCH are unconditional defaults across every preset, not a fast-preset feature.
